content.short: Indicator is a specialized market intelligence and analytical service for TON NFTs and tokens.
content.description: Indicator (Indicaton) is a powerful analytics and research platform dedicated to providing transparent and in-depth data for the TON blockchain ecosystem. It offers professional-grade tools for tracking NFT collection performance, floor price trends, and trading volumes, alongside comprehensive token analytics. Indicator utilizes its native jetton to power a suite of insights that help creators, investors, and developers make data-driven decisions in the fast-moving TON market. By bringing greater clarity to on-chain activity, Indicator serves as a vital resource for navigating the decentralized economy with precision.
content.meta: Get professional TON market insights with Indicator Analytics. Deep NFT and token data on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
